messages:
Marta K: FYI ran the HF->Redwood converter on a new community model and hit a weird combo of problems: special_tokens_map got dropped, plus shard checksums didn't match so weights are misaligned.

Joon Park: ugh. which model + converter version? any logs?

Marta K: model: community/gpt-mini-chat (example), converter: hf2rw-0.9.3 (pip). Repro is quick: run `rw-convert --from hf --model community/gpt-mini-chat --out /tmp/out`. Resulting config.json in output lacks special_tokens_map and the safetensors index lists shards in different order than the downloaded files. Example from output index: 
```json
{
  "weights": ["pytorch_model-00002-of-00002.safetensors", "pytorch_model-00001-of-00002.safetensors"]
}
```
But on disk the files are named as 00001 then 00002; the converter later maps keys assuming index order which renames weight keys incorrectly.

Riley: That ordering issue rings a bell — last month we had a hub-download change that sorts assets lexicographically when crafting the tmp dir. If the index order encodes key->shard mapping then reordering will break the key-to-shard mapping. Also check whether the tool is honoring the HF revision pin (the index can differ across revisions).

Marta K: looked into that. Our logs show it fell back to an unpinned fetch: "Using revision: main (not pinned)". So if a converted checkpoint was created at a specific revision (e.g., v2) and the converter didn't pin, the on-disk shard contents can differ. Log snippet: 
```
INFO:hf_hub: Downloading files for community/gpt-mini-chat
INFO:converter: Using revision: main (not pinned)
WARN:converter: checksum mismatch for pytorch_model-00001-of-00002.safetensors; proceeding with best-effort merge
```

Sam O: that checksum warning is the smoking gun. Also saw downstream eval quality regression after quantization: baseline ppl 18.7 -> 24.3 after convert+int8. Suspect weight-key renames caused heads/embeddings mismap rather than quantization alone.

Laura B: I'll push a small patch: (1) enforce revision pinning from model metadata if present, (2) preserve index ordering and fail fast on checksum mismatch, (3) when mismatch detected, retry with per-file hub download (avoid global sort). Opening PR now. :thumbsup:

Joon Park: can you also add a unit test that simulates mismatched index order (index lists 2 then 1) and asserts we error instead of silently continuing? Add an integration test that compares a few layer norms to the HF artifact to catch key renames.

Laura B: yes to both. Also adding a deterministic quick-eval check (sample 200 tokens, compare logprob delta) so quantization/regression catches show up in CI.

infra-bot: deploy pipeline queued for converter-service (change-id: pr/convert-fix-revision-pin). Estimated build: 18m.

Riley: after the PR lands we should re-run Marta's repro and the quantized eval. If keys line up we should see ppl drop back near baseline or only a small quantization delta.

Marta K: will re-run once PR is merged. If that passes I'll re-run the full eval harness and report numbers here. Thanks all.
